prompt: For the Pixhaus eframe app I want to tune the egui-wgpu setup: prefer the discrete / high-performance GPU, keep vsync on but minimize input latency for brush strokes, and request higher texture-dimension limits so we can support an 8K canvas. Where do these settings live in egui-wgpu and how do I configure them? egui-wgpu 0.34.
assertions: Identifies WgpuConfiguration as the home for these settings
Sets desired_maximum_frame_latency = Some(1) for low input latency
Prefers the discrete GPU via PowerPreference::HighPerformance or native_adapter_selector
Requests higher texture limits via the device_descriptor closure (max_texture_dimension_2d)
Routes config through eframe NativeOptions wgpu_options
